# Join Zulip

Sign up to our Palaeoverse Zulip Workspace!

This is a space to interact with fellow palaeontologists, share useful resources, and post announcements for the broader palaeontological community.

If you are unfamiliar with Zulip as a communication tool, please refer closely to our [personalised user guide](../user-guide/){target="_blank"}. By registering to join this workspace, you are agreeing to follow the guidelines laid out in this document to the best of your ability. Detailed instructions for how to interact with the workspace are also provided in the description of each of our public channels. Please make sure to refer to these before posting. A more exhaustive guide on using Zulip, by the app’s developers, is provided [here](https://zulip.com/help/){target="_blank"}.

As with any community space, we feel it is important to establish some expectations of behaviour whilst interacting with other users. Therefore by registering to join this workspace, you are confirming that you have read, and agree to our [Code of Conduct](../../about/code-of-conduct/){target="_blank"} (CoC). Though the workspace enlists a dedicated team of moderators, if you personally suspect any breach of the rules, we kindly ask that you report these as soon as possible following the instructions provided in our user guide or via the methods detailed in our CoC.

We understand that at times, disputes are likely to occur in our workspace; however, it is expected that respect and professional courtesy are maintained at all times, and we encourage our users to read the following resources: [How to Disagree Well](https://www.ucl.ac.uk/about/disagreeing-well/online-resource){target="_blank"}.

## Disclaimer

By default, Zulip stores messages/posts indefinitely, allowing for a full-text search of your complete history. The public channels on this workspace are accessible to anyone on the Internet via the Zulip API. The following information can therefore be accessed by anybody with internet access:

  * Palaeoverse Workspace settings (linkifiers, custom emoji, permissions settings, etc.)

  * Names of users

  * Affiliations of users

  * Career stage of users

  * All posts in the public channels

  * Names of user groups and their membership

By registering to join this workspace, you are agreeing to these details becoming public.


By registering for this workspace, you acknowledge that your email address will be visible to the workspace Admins.

This is a public forum: the views shared by the poster are their own, and are not necessarily endorsed by Palaeoverse.

By joining this workspace, you confirm that you are over the age of 18.

```{=html}
<style>
.landing-page-btn.disabled {
  opacity: 0.5;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}
</style>
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  const checkbox = document.getElementById("coc-agree");
  const button = document.getElementById("zulip-btn");
  checkbox.addEventListener("change", function () {
    const enabled = checkbox.checked;
    button.classList.toggle("disabled", !enabled);
    button.setAttribute("aria-disabled", String(!enabled));
  });
  // block navigation while disabled (keeps pointer events so the
  // cursor styling applies only over the link itself)
  button.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    if (button.classList.contains("disabled")) {
      e.preventDefault();
    }
  });
});
</script>
```
